name: JB Financial Group Co., Ltd.
summary: JB Financial Group Co., Ltd., utilizing its network of subsidiaries, delivers a comprehensive suite of banking and financial services to both individual consumers and institutional clients, operating across South Korea and global markets. The company's business is structured around three primary divisions: banking, specialized credit finance, and asset management. Its product offerings include various deposit accounts, such as demand, time, and savings deposits, alongside negotiable certificates of deposit. Additionally, it provides loans, leasing arrangements, associated financial services, and installment financing. The group is also actively involved in fund management and strategic securities investments. JB Financial Group Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Jeonju-si, South Korea.
